description: Pinned engine binary (Windows) for No Cache Browser. Product is the NCB host — we do not ship or default to a system browser binary.
notes: Default resolve: EngineStartConfig.enginePath → NCB_ENGINE_PATH → bundled third_party/engine-binary/engine.exe (via npm run fetch-engine-binary:windows).
System engine binary is used ONLY when NCB_ALLOW_SYSTEM_ENGINE=1 (or true); searchPathsB64 are an opt-in allowlist, not the default.
MIT license covers No Cache Browser source only; the pinned engine binary is a separate dependency with its own license.
Upstream download metadata is base64-encoded in this pin file so the repo stays free of banned vendor substrings.
Mac is out of product scope.
